ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible surface with a very low global contrast ratio; high-intensity pixels are restricted to isolated distal tip regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across both lobes with high-contrast, contiguous tan/white clusters located at the 2D coordinate positions of the extreme distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with a narrow interior angle and deep vertical penetration relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Variable frequency serration pattern characterized by small-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire visible trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning to a sharp upward sweep at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white/tan pixel clusters localized at the tips of both fluke lobes, representing distinct surface interruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent light-colored markings on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, contrasting with the dark primary pigmentation.
